implementation_notes: Publish a generated client (from OpenAPI) and use Pact-Python or Schemathesis to verify the supplier against consumer expectations. Pin the client version and keep the contract under version control so a change is reviewable.
code_sketch:
# consumer
p.given("customer 1 exists")
 .upon_receiving("get customer").with_path("/customers/1")
 .will_respond_with(200, body={"id": "1"})

pitfalls: `requests` calls scattered with hand-written paths and no contract at all
Retries and timeouts differing per consumer, turning one outage into many incidents
